_source.title: 外部库元素索引
_source.remarks.text.0: 支持外部库使用名称或 UUID 作为元素的唯一 ID 索引
_source.remarks.text.1: 正常情况下，希望每个库都拥有 UUID，但可能部分系统开发时不存在 UUID 字段（或可以做类似用途的字段）
_source.remarks.text.2: 此处仅传入 `name` 字段时，将把 `name` 做唯一 ID 用途，不可有重名的数据
_source.remarks.text.3: 如若传入 `uuid` 和 `name` 字段，则只有 `uuid` 不可重复
_source.properties.name: 库名称

title: External library item index
remarks.text.0: Supports external libraries using a name or UUID as the unique ID index of the item
remarks.text.1: Under normal circumstances, each library is expected to have a UUID, but some systems may not have a UUID field (or a field that can serve a similar purpose) at development time
remarks.text.2: When only the `name` field is passed here, `name` will be used as the unique ID, and duplicate names are not allowed
remarks.text.3: If both the `uuid` and `name` fields are passed, only `uuid` cannot be duplicated
properties.name: Library name
